name: author a polyglot source file valid under two distinct language toolchains
definition: Write a single source file that is accepted as valid by two different programming-language toolchains, so that each can build it independently.
failure_mode: the file only compiles under one of the required toolchains, or under neither.

name: build a compiler toolchain from its source and configure it for the target runtime
definition: build a compiler toolchain from its source and configure it for the target runtime
failure_mode: the source build does not produce a usable executable, or required toolchain prerequisites are not satisfied.
